Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 36

“Your enemies will speak many unspeakable words, ridiculing your capability. What could be more painful than that?”

The argument reaches its sharpest and most human point. Krishna is deliberately working the wound of pride — an approach he will abandon entirely once Arjuna is ready for something better.
